name: Itsu made mo Musuko no Mama ja Irarenai! ~Kyonyuu de Bijin na Kaa-san wa Ie de wa Muboubi Sugite Boku no Kokan wa Mou Genkai!~
original_name: いつまでも息子のままじゃいられない！ ～巨乳で美人な母さんは家では無防備すぎて僕の股間はもう限界！～
source:
The protagonist, Subaru, has been in love with his mother for a long time.
While trying to hide these deplorable feelings, one day, he accidently pushes her down.

However, she agrees to be his lover until he gets a girlfriend.
And so, the journey trying to become a real lover with his mother begins.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc2/pcl015/musumama.html#story]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公昴很早就爱上了他的母亲。
当他试图掩饰这些悲惨的感情时，有一天，他不小心将她推倒了。

然而，她同意成为他的情人，直到他找到女朋友。
于是，试图与母亲成为真正爱人的旅程开始了。

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc2/pcl015/musumama.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
